method.registration: translation only from configured fixed-feature templates, maximum 10 pixels per axis
method.pingPong: 19 cosine-progress forward frames, then byte-exact copies of forward frames 18..2
method.periodic: Lunge uses a 48-frame full alternating cycle with identical standing reference at anchors 0,8,15; 15-to-0 is an intentional short hold.
method.qaLimit: Contact sheets, onions and pixel metrics support visual review; they do not validate biomechanics or prevent interpolation artifacts.
method.conversion: Approved 72-frame loops use exact odd frame sampling at 12 fps, preserving the 3-second duration. Existing 480-square curl gets one documented 512-square normalization.
method.isometric: Plank depicts a stable isometric position. No repeated flexion or exaggerated breathing is invented.
method.sourceQA: Review projected limb ratios, joint landmarks, equipment rigidity and actual mechanics, in addition to frame continuity; 2D foreshortening is not a biomechanical measurement.

interpolation.runtimeInstall: Use the existing isolated local runtime; this build does not download anything.
